name: dobe_drink6
desc: pink goo doberman seen from behind keeps its pursed muzzle pressed forward into the other face in place like a deep kiss, its mouth stays hidden on the far side and is never visible, no mouth, no teeth, no eye visible. The whole body barely moves: only its head and neck bob very slightly up and down by a couple of pixels like slow steady gulps, the back of its neck gently pulses, a few sticky pink goo strands ooze from the pressed muzzle tip and drip down, arm and lower body stay still, very subtle motion, looping
